game.title: Cratebound
game.tagline: Push, dig and pour your way across six worlds
chapter.1.blurb: Push, climb, dig and pour: crates, ladders, earth and sand.
chapter.2.blurb: Water finds its level: float wood, sink iron, even out the pools.
chapter.3.blurb: Blast cracked rock, light fuses, let the gravel settle.
chapter.4.blurb: Acid eats matching stone, smoke rises, fog sinks.
chapter.5.blurb: Burn through wooden gates, freeze water into bridges.
chapter.6.blurb: Power and machines, decided after the main story.

rule.earth.name: Packed earth
rule.earth.text: Brown earth with pebbles can be dug for one bag of sand. Earth above a dug tile stays put.
level.M01.title: All the Way
level.M01.discovery: Walk into a crate to push it. Push it into the glowing socket.
level.M01.hint.1: The glowing slot is where the crate goes.
level.M01.hint.2: Walking into a crate pushes it.
level.M02.title: Round the Back
level.M02.discovery: Crates only move forward. Climb up, go round the top and drop behind it.
level.M02.hint.1: The crate must go left, so get to its right side.
level.M02.hint.2: There is a ladder on the left and a shaft on the right.
level.M02.hint.3: Climb, walk along the top, drop down the shaft, then push left twice.
level.M03.title: Dig Through
level.M03.discovery: Brown packed earth can be dug. Each dug tile becomes a bag of sand.
level.M03.hint.1: The earth wall is two tiles high, too tall to step over.
level.M03.hint.2: Brown earth with pebbles can be dug.
level.M03.hint.3: Dig the earth on your right, then push the crate.
level.M04.title: A Step of Sand
level.M04.discovery: Poured sand lands as one tile. You can step up one tile, not two.
level.M04.hint.1: The ledge is two tiles high.
level.M04.hint.2: You can climb a single step on your own.
level.M04.hint.3: Pour your bag just before the ledge and climb twice.
level.M05.title: Stand In for Me
level.M05.discovery: A pressed plate opens its door. Let the crate hold the plate while you leave.
level.M05.hint.1: The door and the plate in the pit share a symbol.
level.M05.hint.2: Standing on the plate opens the door, but leaving closes it.
level.M05.hint.3: Push the crate into the plate pit, then walk over it.
level.M06.title: Two Jobs
level.M06.discovery: One crate holds the plate; dug sand makes the step.
level.M06.hint.1: Behind the door there is a two-tile ledge.
level.M06.hint.2: You need something on the plate and one step.
level.M06.hint.3: Dig the earth on the left, push the crate into the pit, pour sand before the ledge.
level.M07.title: Pull the Prop
level.M07.discovery: Dig away what holds a crate up and it falls into the plate pit.
level.M07.hint.1: The crate on the earth is two tiles high.
level.M07.hint.2: Under the earth is the plate pit.
level.M07.hint.3: Dig the earth under the crate.
